disclaimer: These are satellite-detected thermal anomalies (NASA FIRMS), NOT confirmed fire incidents. A hotspot can be a grass fire, agricultural burning, industrial heat, or a false positive; a real structural fire can produce no hotspot at all. The official "Fire Incidents" indicator stays NO DATA / PENDING until BFP Iligan City or ICENRO provide confirmed records, regardless of what this satellite layer shows.
